body:
Hi I have a suggestion regarding the vesting of KQB tokens. I gather currently 30% will vest after KAB wins a parachain slot on KSM wirh the 70% balance vesting at the end of the parachain slot. 
however, on other parachains both on KSM and DOT is it common for 30% to vest upfront with the 70% **vesting linearly over the remaining duration of the parachain slot. **
i think this should not only align KAB with other parachains but also provide more liquidity to the token and ultimately timely rewards for supporters of the project.
